assets.title: Transformation all-hands call (a)
assets.description: A laptop on a warm wooden desk at blue hour, its screen showing a 3x3 video-call grid of a company all-hands: nine international colleagues, one per tile, dissolved soft under the film grade; generic call chrome, no logos.

source.prompt: An open silver laptop on a warm honey-toned wooden desk at blue hour, seen from slightly behind and to the side of the laptop, a window with deep blue dusk light beyond. The laptop screen shows a generic video-call app in a 3x3 grid of nine tiles, a company all-hands meeting, exactly one person per tile, each in their own home or office background, faces small and soft-focus, slightly blurred by the screen glow. The tiles, left to right, top to bottom: (1) a South Asian woman in a mustard-yellow kurta; (2) a Black West African man in a rust-orange patterned shirt; (3) a North African woman in a teal headscarf and cream knit sweater; (4) an East Asian man in a grey crewneck sweatshirt with round glasses; (5) a Middle Eastern man with a beard in an olive-green overshirt; (6) a Latin American woman with curly hair in a faded denim shirt; (7) a Caribbean man in a deep-burgundy hoodie; (8) a white woman with short grey hair in a striped Breton top; (9) a South Asian man in a black t-shirt under a tan corduroy jacket. No suits, no ties. The call interface chrome is minimal, thin and generic: a faint bottom toolbar of small round icons, no names, no readable labels, no logos. A ceramic mug and a closed notebook at the edge of the desk. Cool deep-blue dusk tones dominate with the screen as the only warm-ish glow. No people physically in the room. Cinematic editorial photograph, shot on grainy 35mm film, vintage nostalgic dreamlike mood, atmospheric haze. No readable text, no signage, no logos, no brand marks, no watermark. Not a stock photo, not corporate, not bright.
